column5: At fifteen, Jacques Paganel fell in well with geography after reading Captain Cook’s nautical journal; with a homemade telescope he studied the stars and papered his bedroom walls with maps he drew himself, earning his father’s scolding for neglecting “serious” pursuits.

column4: Involvement and Turning Point in the French Revolution
column5: During the Revolution he acted as a militant republican, attended major assemblies and helped organise trials of royalists.
